name: Weifu High-Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Weifu High-Technology Group Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells automotive products in the People's Republic of China. It operates through four segments: energy saving and emission reduction, intelligent electric drive, green hydrogen energy, and industry and others.
